packageRules.description: One weekly pull request for every minor and patch update; a major still gets its own
A release waits three days, so npm can no longer unpublish it and scanners have had time to check it; Herdr's manifest has no release date, so it is not held

prBodyNotes: Discovery only: this update does not certify compatibility. Minimum and tested versions must remain human-reviewed evidence.
Review the upstream diff and all matching setup/docs/runtime pins before release. Skill candidates do not replace vendored files; reapply local changes and run the selection checks.
A Herdr candidate does not change what its latest-release installer downloads. Promote its tested version only after successful visible-worker smoke runs with both Pi and Claude Code.

customManagers.description: Actual npm install pins, not minimum or tested versions
Herdr upstream candidate only; never rewrite tested
Upstream skill release candidates, never branch commits; vendored provenance remains unchanged
